heroTitleEn: Read the Earth Beneath Your Feet
heroText: 用简单的中文，讲清楚岩石、地貌和地震。马大地质系毕业，现在在京大做地震研究，这里是我的科普频道和生活记录。
heroTextEn: Geology and earthquakes, explained simply. I'm a University of Malaya geology graduate doing seismology research in Kyoto, and this is where I share the science and a bit of everyday life.
